title: Backlog at every month end, by borough; naive vs fast, with and without a Channel filter
notes: 36 month ends of the Date table (2024-01-31 .. 2026-12-31) x 6 boroughs. Check Row is the constant 1 on every row ("constant": 1), so the 12 month ends outside the window, whose measures are all BLANK, are returned and compared cell by cell; one absent from observed is 'missing', a fail (SPEC 9.4). Inside the window a stock is a number, 0 when nothing is open.
SPEC 9.2 fallback: if DAX query view rejects the constant, drop Check Row and regenerate the expected file without the all-BLANK rows (record it in docs/decisions.md).

Comparison per SPEC 9.4: counts and whole numbers exact; hours, ratios and averages relative tolerance 1e-9; BLANK and 0 are different values; booleans, dates and text exact after the display format is normalised (True/TRUE, 8/31/2026 12:00:00 AM, 1,234, 12.5%).
